title: Hay House Storefront Report — Mousa Batarseh
h1: Your Shopify storefront, read cover to cover.
description: An independent Week 0 report on shop.hayhouse.com by Mousa Batarseh: twelve evidence-backed findings, a catalog check of all 874 products, a price check against hayhouse.com, and worked examples for reporting, agentic commerce, SOPs, developer requirements, migration and AI workflows.
